blocks.en: Under suitable hypotheses on the elliptic operator $L$, Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-dirichlet-positive-shift-existence} guarantees that there exists $\lambda_G$ such that if $\widetilde\lambda>\lambda_G$, then for any $f\in H^{-k}(\Omega)$ there exists a unique (weak) solution $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$ of the Dirichlet problem for\[\widetilde L(\bm{x},D)u:=L(\bm{x},D)u+\widetilde\lambda u=f.\]In this section we will apply some of the operator techniques developed in the previous chapter to this problem. This investigation will give us two basic improvements over the present existence theory. First, the Fredholm theorems will give us information on the existence and uniqueness of solutions for values of $\widetilde\lambda<\lambda_G$. Second, if the operator $L$ satisfies a symmetry condition, we can use the method of eigenfunction expansion to construct (or in real life approximate) solutions.
blocks.zh: 在椭圆算子 $L$ 的适当假设下, Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-dirichlet-positive-shift-existence} 保证存在 $\lambda_G$, 使得若 $\widetilde\lambda>\lambda_G$, 则对任意 $f\in H^{-k}(\Omega)$, 下列方程的 Dirichlet 问题存在唯一的 (弱) 解 $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$:\[\widetilde L(\bm{x},D)u:=L(\bm{x},D)u+\widetilde\lambda u=f.\]本节将把前一章中发展的一些算子方法用于这一问题. 这将使现有的存在性理论在两个基本方面得到改进. 首先, Fredholm 定理将提供 $\widetilde\lambda<\lambda_G$ 时解的存在性与唯一性的信息. 其次, 若算子 $L$ 满足某种对称性条件, 则可用特征函数展开法构造解 (在实际中则是近似解).
